definitions.name: Unit Key

protocol.summary: White wire is the active-low key input; yellow wire drives one SK6812 RGB LED. Official KeyUnit combines hardware.Button(active_low=True) with SK6812 on the second UIFlow tuple element.

claims: SKU and chip identity
